checks.result: Reviewed pinned trusted reader, bounded regular canonical archive input, archive digest/stability checks, ZIP structure and entry restrictions, bounded strict JSON, member descriptors and aggregate read limits; no extraction or retained-code execution.

Followed compiler-validation call chains: source/build/tool paths are syntax and equality inputs, never opened or executed. Only trusted local contracts, fixtures, modules and the caller-selected archive are read.

Strict typed before/after source/tool/dependency equality, clean-source claims, exact helper inventories, required retained sources, manifest/fixture/profile/kernel pins, bounded unique initialized module identities; shared .gitmodules parser requires exact declared root count, all roots and nested-only additional entries.

Exact ordered argv/cwd/environment/timeout plans; pass status, cleanup, sampled RSS and log caps; original compiler/linker flags and include order; effective-header logs; generated/copied/configured/frozen identities; reconstructed same-build and process bindings.

Raw original logs reparsed through trusted validators; observed records cannot replace them. Exact fixture words, lifecycle/counter/timing records, process order, complete counts, stability observations and selected-prefix member inventory required before success.

Hosted initialization metadata, retained workflow hash/body, interpreter identity, preparation source/tool/dependency equality, cache keys, allowed quarantine products and relocation identities, final execution output and hosted member inventory checked together.

Warm analysis runs only after complete provenance and raw-log checks. Valid negative hypothesis remains valid evidence. Native execution remains not_run; performance/phase/acceptance flags remain false; producer authentication and physical performance are explicitly excluded.

conclusion: No new concrete F2 or F3 finding in assigned scope.

limitations: This is an author-disjoint static review of the two new readers and their relevant dependencies, not an independent execution of the warm workload.

No fresh unittest, native build, SimX process, RTL, vendor emulation, physical FPGA or silicon execution was performed by W05-A03. Existing test evidence was read and its log identity checked, not counted as this reviewer running the tests.

An externally supplied ZIP digest and source revision identify the expected inputs only to the extent their source is trusted. Self-consistent invented observations do not prove execution or producer honesty.

The readers check retained root/source/submodule bodies and claims for consistency; they do not independently authenticate Git object membership. The separate original-workspace provenance review records its own root-object comparison and submodule limitations.

Binary, toolchain, dependency and quarantined-product hashes are identities; their complete executable/product bodies are not replayed. Recorded compiler/header observations do not amount to rerunning compilation.

The historical workspace reader validates its selected packet and three optional hosted metadata files, not all sibling preparation/execution logs. The warm reader additionally validates its hosted preparation and terminal execution metadata. Standalone packets may have outside-prefix files; success does not certify such files.
Resource supervision is sampled and recorded; replay cannot prove exhaustive OS resource use, all external libraries, all intervening filesystem states or physical memory reclamation.
